newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price rose last week to $17.92.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price rose last week to $17.92.

text.p: The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes rose to $17.92 a barrel last week from $17.22 the previous week, the OPEC news agency said on Monday, quoting the OPEC Secretariat.
The price of the basket so far this year has averaged $19.19, OPECNA said.
In June the price averaged $17.37, versus $18.76 in May and $17.46 in April.
In the second quarter the price averaged $17.83, down from $20.77 in the first quarter, OPECNA said
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus crude.
